startingRecipe: Continue first racing flight after dry crash, acknowledge Glomgold message, then move map cursor Right200 emulated frames; fire; Right; fire, with release gaps. Capture second flight entry, post-terrain, pre/post objects, and first physics. See docs/flight.md.

rules.level: Conditional routine stage comparisons plus complete course setup from original executable constants and PLANE.ARC metadata. Course stages carry their computed seed; not an event-only campaign or full flight replay.
rules.comparison: Exact RNG seed, terrain type/index arrays, allocated object fields, initialization sentinels, loaded sprite geometry/frame bytes, gravity vectors and plane initial state.
conditions: Initial day/difficulty/race/seed are explicit internal starting contracts captured independently at flight entry.
The isolated object-stage check receives captured pre-object memory, including original sprite descriptors.
The two complete setup cases obtain resource dimensions from original PLANE.ARC and constants from DUCKTALE.EXE, without expected-output-derived inputs.
exclusions: Whole setup compares only fields the initialization writes; stale x/state/padding and unused object fields are outside its write footprint. The isolated object-stage comparison covers the full arrays, preserving those values from the before snapshot.
Allocator and driver pointers, stack, software-FPU scratch, hardware state and timing are outside this semantic setup boundary.
No flight rendering, obstacle update, collision or arrival acceptance is claimed.
